newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 9.47 million barrels in the week ended Jan 3 to 286.13 million barrels from 295.60 million barrels in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 7.00 million barrels in the week to 225.47 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.94 million barrels to 126.74 million from 123.80 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 602,000 barrels to 47.20 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 150,000 barrels in the week to 7.66 million bpd from 7.81 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 4.26 million barrels in the week to 196.01 million barrels from 191.75 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity was unchanged at 92.3 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.99 million barrels to 38.68 million barrels from 36.69 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.08 million barrels from 14.09 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 43.37 million barrels from 42.46 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 6.02 million barrels per day from 7.56 million, API said.
